settings.headline:
A safe place to land.
A steady path forward.
settings.copy: Havenwood House is a confidential shelter and support center for women and their children fleeing domestic violence, housing insecurity, or a crisis. We offer a safe bed tonight, and the tools to rebuild lives over the months that follow.

trust_list.text: Confidential, 24/7 intake line — call any time
No income, documents, or referral required
Private bedrooms for every woman and child
Free counseling, legal aid, and case management

settings.title: Safety is only
settings.intro: Every woman who walks through our doors has a different story. Ours is always the same: safety first, then stability, then a future with real options.

settings.title: A whole roof.
settings.intro: A bed is the first night. Long-term safety takes shelter, support, and a road back to independence — we walk every step with you.

design.title: Private bedrooms
design.text: Every woman and child has their own room with a locked door. You choose who knows what — your privacy and dignity come first.

design.title: Meals & essentials
design.text: Three warm meals a day, plus clothing, toiletries, diapers, and anything else you or your kids need. No fees, ever.

design.title: 24/7 staffing
design.text: Trained advocates are on-site around the clock. You are never alone, and your children are always within reach.

build.title: Trauma-informed counseling
build.text: Free, confidential individual and group therapy with counselors who understand what it takes to start over.

build.title: Legal advocacy
build.text: Help with protective orders, custody, immigration, and housing court — with an advocate beside you every time.

build.title: Child & teen services
build.text: Therapists, tutors, and play groups help your kids heal and keep up at school while you rebuild.

launch.title: Case management
launch.text: One advocate works with you from day one to map income, benefits, housing, and goals — at your pace, never on a clock.

launch.title: Job & housing help
launch.text: Resume support, interview prep, childcare, and applications help for apartments, vouchers, and first-month costs.

launch.title: Move-out & aftercare
launch.text: We help you furnish a new home and keep checking in for a year after you leave, so stability lasts.

settings.title: We meet you
settings.intro: Reaching out is the hardest step — and the strongest one. Here's exactly what happens when you call or walk in.

steps.title: Call or walk in
steps.text: Call our 24/7 line or walk in anytime. A live advocate answers — never an automated system — and we assess your safety right away.

steps.title: We make space
steps.text: If we have room, we bring you in that night, no paperwork required. If we don't, we get you somewhere safe with a warm connection.

steps.title: You settle in
steps.text: You get your own room, we meet your immediate needs, and you decide how much you want to share. There are no deadlines.

steps.title: You build your plan
steps.text: When you're ready, an advocate helps you map the next weeks and months — housing, income, legal, family — and we move at your pace.

settings.note: You are never turned away for lack of capacity. If our beds are full, our advocates find you safe alternative housing that same night.

settings.title: Be the reason someone
settings.intro: Your gift pays for beds, meals, counseling, and the legal advocates who stand beside survivors. Every dollar moves a woman closer to independence.
settings.quote: She came to us with nothing but her children and the courage to walk through the door. Today she has a job, a key of her own, and a future that belongs to her.
settings.cta_text: Give a woman a way forward

settings.title: Safety sounds
settings.intro: Survivors and supporters on what a safe door can change.

reviews.quote: The night I walked in, I had twenty dollars and nowhere to be. They gave me a locked door, a hot meal, and a woman who didn't once ask what I did wrong. That was the first time I believed I could start over.
reviews.author: Maya

reviews.quote: Their legal advocate stood beside me in court through every protective order and custody hearing. I never had to face him alone. That presence was worth more than I can say.
reviews.author: Danielle

reviews.quote: We fund Havenwood every quarter. They don't just shelter — they move women all the way to keys and careers. That's where our dollars go, and we see it happen.
reviews.author: T. Welling

settings.title: Call us. Walk in.
settings.intro: Reaching out is confidential and free. An advocate answers every call — day or night — and you never need a referral, ID, or proof of income to get help.

settings.blurb: Havenwood House is a confidential women's shelter and support center offering safety, healing, and a path to independence for women and children in crisis.
